ledger: Phone screen center text: blurry 'A742' at 00:00-00:02; sharpens to 'Ā7·42' at 00:03-00:04; morphs to 'ĀZ·42' at 00:05-00:06; reverts to 'Ā7·42' at 00:07-00:08; warps into '04W' / 'UAW' as the phone tilts at 00:09.

Phone screen top header text: reads 'A7' at 00:03; changes to 'AA' with a curved overline at 00:04-00:05; gains a boxy symbol between the letters at 00:06; reverts to 'AA' with an overline at 00:07-00:08.
Phone screen top-left status bar: displays a green icon followed by '7.4Z' from 00:04 to 00:08.
Phone screen lower text: displays 'AZ - 12' beneath a small garbled glyph from 00:04 to 00:08.

findings.description: Once the smartphone screen comes into sharp focus, its interface consists of incoherent, garbled pseudo-text, including '7.4Z' next to the battery icon, an 'AA' header with malformed diacritics, a central 'Ā7·42' readout mixing letters and numbers, and a malformed glyph above 'AZ - 12'.

findings.entity: Phone screen center and header text
findings.description: The text elements on the screen morph repeatedly without any screen interaction: the upper header changes from 'A7' (00:03) to 'AA' (00:04) and gains a square artifact between the letters (00:06), while the central 'Ā7·42' text shifts to 'ĀZ·42' at 00:05-00:06, reverts to 'Ā7·42' at 00:07, and warps into '04W' as the phone tilts down at 00:09.
